name: Uptown Funk AI Video
tagline: Put your crew in the viral AI CEO dance, from one selfie.
description: Uptown Funk AI Video puts you and your friends into the viral AI CEO dance. Upload one lead photo plus up to four crew photos and get a 15-second video of the Uptown Funk street dance with your faces, the original song and lip-sync. 768p or 2K HD, from $9.99, no subscription. Not affiliated with Mark Ronson or Bruno Mars.
